data.body:
DECISION RECORDED (satisfies the "name which option was taken and why" criterion) + SUITE EVIDENCE.

OPTION TAKEN: option 1 — do the seam extraction. Rejected the two alternatives deliberately:
  - Re-deriving the <700 target from today's baseline would edit a CLOSED story's ATTESTED acceptance
    criterion (2682), which is not a unilateral call.
  - A re-export shim to scrape under the limit by two lines is the "split mechanically to hit a number"
    that the module-size policy explicitly forbids.

WHAT WAS MOVED AND WHY THERE: `_import_pydantic_ai` (the pydantic-ai import seam) and `_pai_check_config`
(its config preflight) moved from runner.py into structured_run.py. structured_run.py was chosen over a
NEW module deliberately: the cluster is ~40 LOC and the policy forbids creating files under 100 LOC by
splitting. structured_run.py already owns `_pai_structured`, so this keeps all the `_pai_*` plumbing in
one module rather than scattering it. Result: runner.py 713 -> 680 (real headroom, not a two-line
margin); structured_run.py 212 -> 255.

ZERO TEST EDITS, which is the property 2682 established and this had to preserve. `_import_pydantic_ai`
is monkeypatched via `setattr(runner_mod, ...)` in NINE test files (test_llm_temperature,
test_llm_timeouts, test_llm_provider_factory, test_agent_build_invariants, test_pydantic_ai_runner x2,
test_bedrock_provider, test_web_tool_gating, tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch) and
`_pai_check_config` is imported from `rebar.llm.runner` in THREE more (test_openai_compatible_provider).
runner re-imports both, so they remain ITS module-globals and all 15 reference sites resolve unchanged.

[operator-attested] FULL SUITE ON THE REBASED STACK:
  8143 passed, 74 skipped, 17 warnings, 0 failed  (pytest -q -n auto, exit code 0)
  make lint      -> exit 0
  make typecheck -> exit 0 (402 source files)
Run from the worktree /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-wt-provider-seam on branch feat/llm-provider-seam, rebased
onto current origin/main, with the extraction applied.

INDEPENDENT CI CORROBORATION: change 1081 ("3a98: move pai preflight into structured_run") carries
LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 — CI agreed with the local run on the same tree.

NOTE on an earlier INVALID suite run, recorded so it is not mistaken for a real failure: one run of this
suite reported 8 failed / 33 errors with "Test moved the repo HEAD". That was a concurrent git rebase
executing in the same worktree while pytest was reading it — my own rule violation, not a code defect.
The clean re-runs (8131, then 8143 after 1903) are the valid ones.
